{{Quote|Our antique robo-fountain once stood in Old Doc 8H-QD9's Antivirus Software-Shoppe, a popular hangout for youths out cruising in speeders and engaging in awkward mating rituals. We've restored the device to its original working condition, offering you a chance to experience all the fun and romance of the Republic's golden age with every drink|Dex's Diner menu, on its robo-fountain|<ref name="Menu" />}}
A '''robo-fountain''' was a device used to prepare [[Foodstuff/Legends|beverages]] with various flavored [[Syrup/Legends|syrups]]. At least one robo-fountain was installed at [[Old Doc 8H-QD9's Antivirus Software-Shoppe]], a popular place for youths to socializing with each other. A robo-fountain from Old Doc 8H-QD9's was later acquired, restored, and installed at the [[Restaurant/Legends|eatery]] [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="Menu" /> At some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]],<ref name="DexDates">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/dexdiner/index.html|text=Dining at Dex's|int=Dining at Dex's}} is set at some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]] per the {{DiningAtDexDate}}.</ref> the diner served a variety of [[fizzyglug]] beverages along with the customers choice of a flavored syrup from its robo-fountain. The diner also served [[Blue milkshake/Legends|blue milkshakes]] that were mixed by a robotic appendage using [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]-cold [[Ice cream/Legends|ice cream]], [[Blue milk/Legends|blue milk]] and robo-fountain flavored syrups.<ref name="Menu" />

==Behind the scenes==
Robo-fountains were created<ref name="Story Behind">{{Blog|narbflick|11|Dining at Dex's: The Story Behind the Story}}</ref> for "[[Dining at Dex's]]," an article written by [[Gregory Walker]] as an [[in-universe]] menu for Dex's Diner that was published on the [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] section of [[StarWars.com]] on [[December 3]], [[2009]].<ref name="Menu" />
